preconditions.description: The input root is a valid node of a binary tree.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node.val, int) and node.val >= 0 for node in all_nodes(root))
preconditions.description: Every node in the tree has a non-negative integer value representing the number of candies.

preconditions.expression: sum(node.val for node in all_nodes(root)) == count_nodes(root)
preconditions.description: The total number of candies in the tree equals the number of nodes, ensuring a solution exists where every node ends with exactly one candy.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(abs(flow(node)) for node in all_nodes(root) if node != root)
postconditions.description: The returned value equals the sum of absolute flows across all edges in the tree, where flow(node) is the net number of candies that must move between a node and its parent to balance the subtree rooted at that node.
The number of moves is a non-negative integer.

helper_definitions.all_nodes: A function that returns a list of all nodes in the binary tree rooted at the given node, traversing recursively.
helper_definitions.count_nodes: A function that returns the total number of nodes in the binary tree rooted at the given node.
helper_definitions.flow: A function that computes the net candy flow for a node: (sum of candies in subtree rooted at node) - (number of nodes in subtree rooted at node). This represents the number of candies that must leave (if positive) or enter (if negative) the subtree via the edge to its parent.
